description: The agent must execute a 3-part chained workflow: (1) CONTRACT RISK SCAN — Read `input_contract.txt` and `references/risk-patterns.md`, then produce a structured risk table using exactly '高/中/低' risk levels identifying at least 3 critical risks: the illegal unilateral job-transfer clause (HR-HIGH-003), the severely underpaid non-compete clause (HR-HIGH-002 — ¥1,000/month compensation for a full-China ban is grossly insufficient), and the illegal arbitration-final clause that strips the employee of court access. (2) COMPENSATION CALCULATION — Read `references/calculation-formulas.md` and `references/labor-dispute-scenarios.md` to determine: 末位淘汰 = illegal termination → 2N rule applies; work period ≈ 2 years 10 months → rounds up to 3N units; monthly salary = ¥22,000; therefore N = ¥66,000, 2N = ¥132,000, plus 1 month代通知金 = ¥22,000 (since no advance notice), total estimate ¥132,000–¥154,000. The agent MUST invoke `scripts/calculate_lawsuit_fee.py` with the dispute amount as an argument to get the litigation fee estimate (e.g., python scripts/calculate_lawsuit_fee.py 132000 → ¥3,350). (3) COMPLAINT SKELETON — Read `references/document-skeletons.md` and `assets/complaint-template.md` to generate a structured 起诉状骨架 with: 原告/被告 populated from case facts, 诉讼请求 section, 事实与理由 section, a populated 证据清单, and a 缺失事实清单. (4) MANDATORY ELEMENTS — The output MUST include a 免责声明 (disclaimer) and an upgrade hint mentioning Pro/Business version. All content must go into `legal_analysis_report.md`.
